_comment: Template for the voice relay's settings file. Copy to voice-realtime.settings.json (git-ignored) and point VOICE_REALTIME_SETTINGS_PATH at it; the server reads it once per connection. Unknown keys, including this one, are ignored. Every key is optional: an omitted key keeps the shipped default.
_version: A non-empty string logged beside every injection, so an edit is visible in the log.
contextTemplate:
以下是当前 Claude Code 会话的上下文（用户看得见的内容，最新在后）。

{{context}}
_contextTemplate: The block that introduces the context pack; it must carry {{context}}.
_turnDetection: The upstream detector, in wire spelling. Fields left out fall through to the environment and then to the shipped 800 ms window.
_omissionFill: A partial override of the omission-fill producer's parameters, in the snake_case spelling of server/modules/voice-realtime/omission-fill-params.json. An empty object keeps the shipped values.
_announcePhrases: The announce closing turn's sentence table, '|'-separated. Needs at least 3 phrases; each at most 15 characters. Invalid values are refused whole and the shipped table is used.
_contextPack: The C2 context pack's size, consumed by both Live Voice and one-shot dictation. Ranges: maxRows 1-12, budgetChars 200-4000, rowCapChars 100-2000. Precedence: environment (VOICE_REALTIME_CONTEXT_MAX_ROWS / VOICE_REALTIME_CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHARS / VOICE_REALTIME_CONTEXT_ROW_CAP_CHARS) > this file > shipped default (4 / 1200 / 600). Fields left out keep the default; a known field out of range refuses the WHOLE block and the defaults apply, with the reason reported in the connection log. The browser also enforces a hard ceiling of 12 rows / 4,000 chars / 2,000 per row.
_spendGuard: The Live Voice per-window spend cap. Ranges: maxCnyPerWindow 0.001-10 CNY; windowMs 5000-60000 ms. Precedence: the HTTP diagnosis route's per-run override > environment (VOICE_REALTIME_MAX_CNY_PER_30S) > this file > the ¥0.05 / 30 s default. The guard is NEVER disabled: there is no null/0 spelling for 'off', and a refused value keeps the default armed and is reported in the connection log. Changes reach the NEXT connection (and the next one-shot upload / runtime-config request); a live session keeps the reading it connected with.
_speakerTracking: Phase 1 speaker tracking (shadow only). 'mode' is off or shadow; modelPath, when non-empty, wins over join(modelDir, modelFile). Every threshold/quality value left out keeps the frozen thresholds.v1.json default. An invalid block refuses the WHOLE file, so the connection runs with defaults and the reason is logged.
_speakerModel: The CAM++ checkpoint is NOT shipped: models/ is git-ignored and excluded from the npm/Electron bundles. Install it from Settings -> Voice -> Live Voice -> Speaker model, which asks the server to download it from the fixed sherpa-onnx release URL, verifies the pinned sha256 and renames the file into modelDir/modelFile (or modelPath) atomically. The path shown there is the directory the next Live Voice connection will load.
_speakerTracking_escapeHatch: VOICE_SPEAKER_TRACKING / VOICE_SPEAKER_MODEL_PATH still work for a test or an operator, but only as escape hatches: they override this block (environment > settings file > default).
